<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Bright Steel — Product Card
  PATH:   Custom/BrightSteel/Product_Card.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  The paper product card, in Fishbowl. One card per product: a date-ordered
  ledger of everything bought and everything sold, with the batch, the average
  bar length, the bar count and a running kilo balance — exactly the columns of
  the hand-written card it replaces:

      Date | Customer / Supplier | Invoice No | Order No | Price |
      Shipment | Length | Bars | In/Out | Balance

  IT IS DRIVEN BY ORDER LINES, NOT BY THE INVENTORY LOG
  ----------------------------------------------------
  Four branches, UNION-ed and sorted by the date the stock is expected to move:

    IN   Receipt   one row per receiptitem, dated receiptitem.dateReceived
         On order  the UNRECEIVED remainder of the poitem, dated
                   poitem.dateScheduledFulfillment
    OUT  Shipment  one row per shipitem, dated ship.dateShipped
         Due out   the UNSHIPPED remainder of the soitem, dated
                   soitem.dateScheduledFulfillment

  So a line that ships in three goes gets three rows at three dates plus, while
  anything is still owed, a fourth row at its scheduled date. A line nobody has
  touched yet appears once, at the date it is due. That is the "expected
  movement date" ordering the card is kept in.

  COLUMN MAPPING  (confirmed with the business before build)
    Date                 IN  receiptitem.dateReceived, else poitem.dateScheduledFulfillment
                         OUT ship.dateShipped,         else soitem.dateScheduledFulfillment
    Customer / Supplier  IN  vendor.name via po.vendorId · OUT customer.name via so.customerId
    Invoice No           IN  po.vendorSO   (the SUPPLIER's invoice number)
                         OUT so.num        (our own invoice number)
    Order No             IN  po.num        (our purchase order)
                         OUT so.customerPO (their PO, or the name of whoever rang)
    Price                IN  poitem.unitCost · OUT soitem.unitPrice — both per kilo and both in
                         the HOME currency (the plain columns are home; mc* are the order's own
                         currency and ride along in hidden columns)
    Shipment             the BATCH: the part's text tracking value for that movement
    Length               the batch's AVERAGE LENGTH tracking value, in metres per bar
    Bars                 parsed out of the sales order line note ("5 bars"), falling back to
                         kg / (kg-per-metre x length) where the note says nothing
    In / Out             the movement in the part's base unit, + for in, - for out
    Balance              running, from a brought-forward opening figure

  A row that has not moved yet has NO batch and NO length — there is no tag
  behind it, so there is nothing to read. Those cells are deliberately blank.

  BALANCE, AND HOW IT TIES BACK TO REAL STOCK
  -------------------------------------------
    B/F        = on hand now  -  every NET inventorylog movement since the range
                 start (i.e. what was genuinely on hand the day the card opens).
                 "Net" is load-bearing: inventorylog type 40 (`yld`) duplicates
                 movements other rows already carry, so it is excluded. Summing
                 it in produced a B/F of -228 on a part holding 26.5 and a
                 fictitious +228 reconciliation row to cover the gap.
    Balance    = B/F + every In/Out above this row, rolled in TWO passes:
                 history first (closing on real on-hand), then the forecast
                 continuing from that close. One combined pass let an overdue
                 On-order row in the middle of the card shift every later
                 historical balance.
    A card built only from orders cannot see stock adjustments, cycle counts or
    transfers. Rather than let the closing figure quietly drift away from what
    is really in the rack, the difference is shown as its OWN dated row —
    "Adjustments / transfers (not on an order)" — so the running balance ties
    to real on-hand at today's date and the projection past today starts from
    the right number. If that row is absent, nothing is unaccounted for.

  SCOPE  all location groups the user can see, with an optional filter.
  The Balance column is a running total in DATE order. Sorting the grid by
  another column reorders the rows but each keeps the balance it had on the
  date it happened — as a reprinted ledger does.

  STATUS: desk-built against the Fishbowl schema. NOT yet exercised against a
  live Bright Steel database — the "Weight per Meter" custom field and the
  "Batch Number" / "Length" tracking fields do not exist in any test database,
  so their auto-detection needs a first run on site (Settings > Fields
  overrides all three).

  DEPLOY ORDER (re-save on the server, in this order, or the report breaks):
    1. fb-styles  (Style  named exactly "fb-styles", source scripts/fb-styles.css)
    2. fb-lib     (Script named exactly "fb-lib",    source scripts/fb-lib.js)
    3. THIS report (the shared-asset directives only re-run on save)
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>- Part - Bright Steel Product Card - Fishbowl BI</title>

    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Moment.js — date formatting parity with the rest of the suite
         (FBLib.Common.formatDate prefers it when present). -->
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
         Script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. Provides FBLib.Common
         (formatting, drawers, multi-select, debug drawer), FBLib.Settings,
         FBLib.Table and FBLib.Export. -->
    <script>
        {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI stylesheet — inlined from the saved "fb-styles"
         Style (scripts/fb-styles.css). MUST come BEFORE the inline block so
         per-report rules win the cascade on identical selectors. -->
    <style>
        {% Style fb-styles %}
    </style>

    <style>
        /* =====================================================
           BASE + LAYOUT — tokens live in fb-styles; style new work off
           var(--…), never a hardcoded hex.
           ===================================================== */
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-primary); background: var(--bg-1);
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh;
            padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
            transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
        }
        header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
        #statusLine { font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); line-height: 1.15; margin: 2px 0 0; }
        .hdr-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

        /* =====================================================
           INPUT BAR
           ===================================================== */
        #inputBar {
            display: flex; align-items: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 14px;
            background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 9px 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
            position: relative; z-index: 30;   /* dropdowns escape the bar */
        }
        .fbar-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
        .fbar-field > label {
            font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--c-secondary);
        }
        .fbar-field select,
        .fbar-field input[type=text],
        .fbar-field input[type=date] {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; font-family: inherit; color: #415157;
            height: 28px;
        }
        .fbar-field select:focus, .fbar-field input:focus {
            outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,156,219,0.18);
        }
        .fbar-ms { width: 200px; }
        .fbar-ms .ms-trigger { min-height: 28px; }
        .fbar-dates { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
        .fbar-dates span { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 12px; }
        .fbar-dates input[type=date] { width: 132px; }
        .fbar-btn {
            height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff; color: #415157; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .fbar-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
        .fbar-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 8px; }
        #partInput { width: 250px; }

        /* Typeahead popup under the part input. */
        .ac-wrap { position: relative; }
        .ac-dropdown {
            position: absolute; z-index: 700; top: calc(100% + 3px); left: 0;
            min-width: 320px; max-width: 520px;
            background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 7px;
            box-shadow: var(--sh2); max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .ac-dropdown.hidden { display: none; }
        .ac-item {
            display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 9px;
            padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-1);
        }
        .ac-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .ac-item:hover, .ac-item.active { background: var(--tint-blue); }
        .ac-item .ac-label { font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); white-space: nowrap; }
        .ac-item .ac-sub   { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 11px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
        .ac-empty, .ac-loading { padding: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }
        .ac-loading { font-style: italic; }

        /* =====================================================
           CARD HEAD — the printed head of the paper card: size / grade /
           kg per metre / brought-forward, plus the reconciliation strip.
           ===================================================== */
        #cardHead {
            display: none; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 24px;
            background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; padding: 9px 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        #cardHead.on { display: flex; }
        .ch-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; margin-right: 6px; }
        .ch-num  { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
        .ch-desc { font-size: 11.5px; color: #B7CBD4; }
        .ch-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; line-height: 1.2; }
        .ch-stat .k {
            font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #8FAEBB;
        }
        .ch-stat .v { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .ch-stat.hero .v { color: #7FD3F5; font-size: 18px; }
        .ch-stat.proj .v { color: #F7C23A; }
        .ch-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }
        .ch-warn {
            background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con);
            border: 1px solid var(--acc-orange); border-radius: var(--r-pill);
            padding: 3px 11px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* =====================================================
           APP SHELL + TABLE — the classes FBLib.Table.init expects.
           ===================================================== */
        .app-shell { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
        .fb-table-container { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: #fff; }
        table.fb-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; table-layout: fixed; }
        table.fb-table th {
            background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 500;
            padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: grab; user-select: none; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10;
            overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        table.fb-table th:active { cursor: grabbing; }
        table.fb-table th:hover { background: #164A5F; }
        table.fb-table th.sort-asc::after  { content: ' \2191'; opacity: 0.8; }
        table.fb-table th.sort-desc::after { content: ' \2193'; opacity: 0.8; }
        table.fb-table th.col-drag-over { background: #164A5F; border-left: 3px solid #CBE5FB; }
        table.fb-table tr.filter-row { display: none; }
        table.fb-table td {
            padding: 3px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); white-space: nowrap;
            vertical-align: middle; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        table.fb-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: var(--bg-1); }
        table.fb-table tr:hover td { background: var(--tint-blue) !important; }
        .fb-col-resize { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; width: 6px; height: 100%; cursor: col-resize; user-select: none; }
        .fb-col-resize:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .fb-row-link { color: var(--link); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
        .fb-row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--link-hover); }

        .num-cell { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .muted-cell { color: var(--c-tertiary); }

        /* A header that carries an explanation. The cursor stays `grab` —
           the header is still the drag handle for reordering — so the hint
           has to be visual: a dotted rule under the label. */
        table.fb-table th.has-tip {
            text-decoration: underline dotted rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
            text-underline-offset: 3px;
        }
        table.fb-table th.has-tip:hover { text-decoration-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); }
        /* .app-tooltip itself ships from fb-styles; these are the IN/OUT rows
           this report adds inside it. */
        .app-tooltip .tt-io { display: block; margin-top: 5px; }
        .app-tooltip .tt-io b { color: #7FD3F5; font-weight: 700; }
        .app-tooltip .tt-io.out b { color: #F7C23A; }
        .app-tooltip code {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 3px;
            padding: 0 3px; font-size: 10.5px;
        }

        /* The paper card used red ink for purchases and black for sales. The
           sign does that job here, on the one column where it matters. */
        .io-in   { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fb-success); }
        .io-out  { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fb-negative); }
        .io-adj  { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; color: var(--acc-orange-con); }
        .bal-cell { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); }
        .bal-cell.proj { color: var(--c-secondary); font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; }

        /* A row that has not happened yet. Kept fully legible — it is real
           demand and real supply — but visibly not history. */
        tr.sched td { background: #FCFBF6 !important; }
        tr.sched:nth-child(even) td { background: #F7F5EE !important; }
        tr.sched:hover td { background: var(--tint-blue) !important; }
        tr.sched td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 0 var(--acc-yellow); }
        /* The reconciliation row. Deliberately loud — it is the report telling
           you the orders do not explain all of the stock movement. */
        tr.adj td { background: var(--acc-orange-bg) !important; }
        tr.adj:hover td { background: #F0DBC8 !important; }
        tr.adj td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 0 var(--acc-orange); }

        .pill {
            display: inline-block; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-pill);
            font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        }
        .pill-recv  { background: var(--acc-sage);      color: var(--acc-sage-con); }
        .pill-order { background: var(--tint-blue);     color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
        .pill-ship  { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); color: var(--acc-maroon-con); }
        .pill-due   { background: var(--acc-yellow-bg); color: var(--acc-yellow-con); }
        .pill-adj   { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); border: 1px solid var(--acc-orange); }

        /* Empty / prompt state. */
        #emptyState {
            flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px;
            color: var(--c-tertiary); text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px;
        }
        #emptyState.hidden { display: none; }
        #emptyState .es-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        #emptyState .es-sub { font-size: 12.5px; max-width: 470px; line-height: 1.55; }

        /* Columns panel. */
        .col-wrap { position: relative; }
        #colPanel {
            position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 4px); z-index: 600;
            width: 236px; max-height: 340px; overflow-y: auto;
            background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--sh2);
        }
        #colPanel.hidden { display: none; }
        #colPanel .col-head {
            padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--c-tertiary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); position: sticky; top: 0; background: #fff;
        }
        #colPanel label {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 11px;
            font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; color: #415157;
        }
        #colPanel label:hover { background: var(--tint-blue); }
        #colPanel .col-foot { padding: 6px 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bg-2); position: sticky; bottom: 0; background: #fff; }

        /* Drawer chrome (settings / help). */
        .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #415157; }
        .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
        .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .ds-btn-admin { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); border-color: var(--acc-orange); color: var(--acc-orange-con); margin-right: 6px; }
        .ds-lock-badge { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); border: 1px solid var(--acc-orange); padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
        .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }
        .fb-grid-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); align-items: start; }
        .fb-grid-cols .fb-group { flex: none; min-width: 0; }
        .fb-group-title {
            font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--c-secondary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); }
        .fb-field select, .fb-field input[type=text] {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-1); font-family: inherit; color: #415157;
        }
        .fb-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); line-height: 1.45; }
        .help-p { font-size: 12px; color: #415157; line-height: 1.5; margin: 4px 0; }
        .help-l { font-size: 12px; color: #415157; padding-left: 18px; margin: 4px 0; line-height: 1.55; }
        .help-tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px; margin: 6px 0; }
        .help-tbl th, .help-tbl td { text-align: left; padding: 3px 7px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); vertical-align: top; }
        .help-tbl th { color: var(--c-secondary); font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
        .help-tbl td code { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
        /* The drawer backdrop scrim is injected + managed by fb-lib
           (registerDrawer -> #fbDrawerScrim). Never add a local scrim, and
           never override `.fb-drawer.open { z-index }` — the drawer must keep
           the fb-styles z-index (10001) that sits above fb-lib's scrim. */

        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar, .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar, #colPanel::-webkit-scrollbar, .ac-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track, .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track, #colPanel::-webkit-scrollbar-track, .ac-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: 4px; }
        .fb-drawer-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .fb-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, #colPanel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .ac-dropdown::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; }

        @media print {
            html, body { overflow: visible; }
            @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 0.5in; }
            header, #inputBar, .hdr-btn, .fb-drawer, .fblib-debug-drawer, #colPanel { display: none !important; }
            .fb-table-container { overflow: visible !important; }
            table.fb-table th { position: static !important; background: #ddd !important; color: #000 !important; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="toast-container" id="toastContainer"></div>
<!-- Shared styled tooltip — content is swapped in on hover by tipShow().
     The .app-tooltip skin ships from fb-styles. -->
<div id="appTooltip" class="app-tooltip"></div>

<!-- ==================== HEADER ==================== -->
<header>
    <div>
        <h1>Bright Steel — Product Card</h1>
        <p id="statusLine">Loading…</p>
    </div>
    <div class="hdr-actions">
        <div class="col-wrap" id="colWrap">
            <button id="colBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="toggleColPanel()" title="Show / hide columns (drag a header to reorder, drag its edge to resize)">
                <svg fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="8" cy="6" r="1.5"/><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="8" cy="18" r="1.5"/><circle cx="16" cy="6" r="1.5"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="1.5"/><circle cx="16" cy="18" r="1.5"/></svg>
                Columns
            </button>
            <div id="colPanel" class="hidden">
                <div class="col-head">Show / hide</div>
                <div id="colList"></div>
                <div class="col-foot">
                    <button type="button" class="fbar-btn" style="width:100%;" onclick="resetColLayout()" title="Reset column order, widths and visibility">Reset layout</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <button id="refreshBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="loadCard()" title="Re-read the card">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"/></svg>
            Refresh
        </button>
        <button id="csvBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="exportCsv()" title="Download the card as CSV">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/></svg>
            CSV
        </button>
        <button id="xlsxBtn" class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="exportXlsx()" title="Download as a formatted Excel workbook">
            <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M8 8l8 8M16 8l-8 8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
            Excel

// ============================================================================
//  PART TYPEAHEAD
// ============================================================================
var _acRows = [], _acActive = -1, _acSeq = 0;

function onPartInput() {
    var v = document.getElementById('partInput').value.trim();
    if (v.length === 0) { closeAc(); return; }
    showAc('<div class="ac-loading">Searching…</div>');
    _acDebounced(v);
}
var _acDebounced = debounce(function (term) { acFetch(term); }, 180);

async function acFetch(term) {
    var mySeq = ++_acSeq;
    var t = escSQL(term);
    var sql = [
        'SELECT p.id AS partid, p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc,',
        '       p.uomId AS uomid, u.code AS uomcode',
        'FROM part p',
        'JOIN uom u ON u.id = p.uomId',
        "WHERE p.activeFlag = 1 AND p.typeId = 10",
        "  AND (p.num LIKE '%" + t + "%' OR p.description LIKE '%" + t + "%')",
        "ORDER BY (p.num LIKE '" + t + "%') DESC, p.num",
        'LIMIT 25'
    ].join('\n');
    try {
        var rows = await qp(sql);
        if (mySeq !== _acSeq) return;
        _acRows = rows || [];
        _acActive = _acRows.length ? 0 : -1;
        renderAc();
    } catch (e) {
        if (mySeq !== _acSeq) return;
        showAc('<div class="ac-empty">Search failed: ' + escHtml(errText(e)) + '</div>');
    }
}

function renderAc() {
    if (!_acRows.length) { showAc('<div class="ac-empty">No matching products</div>'); return; }
    var html = _acRows.map(function (r, i) {
        return '<div class="ac-item' + (i === _acActive ? ' active' : '') + '" data-i="' + i + '">' +
               '<span class="ac-label">' + escHtml(r.partnum) + '</span>' +
               '<span class="ac-sub">' + escHtml(r.partdesc || '') + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    showAc(html);
    document.querySelectorAll('#acDropdown .ac-item').forEach(function (el) {
        // mousedown, not click — it beats the input's blur-triggered close.
        el.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            pickPart(parseInt(el.dataset.i, 10));
        });
    });
}
function showAc(html) { var dd = document.getElementById('acDropdown'); dd.innerHTML = html; dd.classList.remove('hidden'); }
function closeAc()   { var dd = document.getElementById('acDropdown'); if (dd) dd.classList.add('hidden'); _acRows = []; _acActive = -1; }

function pickPart(i) {
    var row = _acRows[i];
    if (!row) return;
    document.getElementById('partInput').value = row.partnum;
    closeAc();
    selectPart(rowToPart(row));
}
function rowToPart(r) {
    return {
        id: parseInt(r.partid, 10),
        num: r.partnum,
        description: r.partdesc || '',
        uomid: parseInt(r.uomid, 10),
        uomcode: r.uomcode || ''
    };
}

function onPartKeydown(e) {
    var dd = document.getElementById('acDropdown');
    var open = dd && !dd.classList.contains('hidden') && _acRows.length > 0;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && open) { e.preventDefault(); _acActive = (_acActive + 1) % _acRows.length; renderAc(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && open) { e.preventDefault(); _acActive = (_acActive - 1 + _acRows.length) % _acRows.length; renderAc(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        if (open && _acActive >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); pickPart(_acActive); }
        else { e.preventDefault(); closeAc(); resolveTypedPart(); }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeAc(); }
}

async function resolveTypedPart() {
    var v = document.getElementById('partInput').value.trim();
    if (!v) return;
    try {
        var rows = await qp(
            'SELECT p.id AS partid, p.num AS partnum, p.description AS partdesc, p.uomId AS uomid, u.code AS uomcode ' +
            'FROM part p JOIN uom u ON u.id = p.uomId ' +
            "WHERE p.num = '" + escSQL(v) + "' LIMIT 1");
        if (rows && rows.length) selectPart(rowToPart(rows[0]));
        else setStatus('No product numbered "' + v + '".');
    } catch (e) { setStatus('Lookup failed — ' + errText(e)); }
}

// ============================================================================
//  PART SELECTION -> FIELD RESOLUTION
//  (Shared with the Bars-to-Kilos report — same three fields, same detector.)
// ============================================================================
async function selectPart(p) {
    _part = p;
    _rows = [];
    if (_resolve('remember', true)) _setUserKey('lastPart', p.num);
    await resolvePartFields();
    await loadCard();
}

async function resolvePartFields() {
    if (!_part) return;

    var chosenCf = String(_resolve('kgpmCf', '') || '');
    var cf = chosenCf || autoDetectKgpmField();
    _part.kgpmField = cf;
    _part.kgpm = 0;
    if (cf) {
        try {
            var rows = await qp(
                "SELECT CustomFieldByName(p.customFields, '" + escSQL(cf) + "') AS v " +
                'FROM part p WHERE p.id = ' + _part.id + ' LIMIT 1');
            _part.kgpm = parseNum(rows && rows.length ? rows[0].v : null);
        } catch (e) { debugLog('Kg-per-metre lookup failed: ' + errText(e), 'warn'); }
    }

    _partTrks = [];
    try {
        _partTrks = await qp([
            'SELECT pt.id AS trkid, pt.name AS trkname, pt.abbr AS trkabbr,',
            '       pt.typeId AS trktype, pt.sortOrder AS sortorder',
            'FROM parttotracking p2t',
            'JOIN parttracking pt ON pt.id = p2t.partTrackingId',
            'WHERE p2t.partId = ' + _part.id + ' AND pt.activeFlag = 1',
            'ORDER BY pt.sortOrder, pt.name'
        ].join('\n'));
    } catch (e) { debugLog('Tracking lookup failed: ' + errText(e), 'warn'); }

    _batchTrk = pickTracking(String(_resolve('batchTrk', '') || ''), TRK_TEXT,   /batch|lot|heat|cast|shipment/i);
    _lenTrk   = pickTracking(String(_resolve('lenTrk',   '') || ''), TRK_LENGTH, /len|length/i);

    debugLog('Part ' + _part.num + ' — kg/m field "' + (cf || '(none)') + '" = ' + _part.kgpm +
             ', batch = ' + (_batchTrk ? _batchTrk.trkname : '(none)') +
             ', length = ' + (_lenTrk ? _lenTrk.trkname : '(none)'), 'info');
    refreshFieldSelects();
}

// Bright Steel's field is named "Weight per Meter" — WEIGHT, not kg — so the
// detector matches any mass word. Same implementation as the Bars-to-Kilos
// report; keep the two in step.
function autoDetectKgpmField() {
    var norm = function (s) { return String(s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim(); };
    var MASS  = /\b(kgs?|kilos?|kilograms?|weight|wt|mass)\b/;
    // Bare "m" is safe here because norm() splits on punctuation, so "gm" in
    // "Unit Weight gm" stays one token and cannot match.
    var METRE = /\b(metres?|meters?|m|lm|lin|linear)\b/;
    var exact = _partCfs.find(function (n) {
        return /^(kgs?|kilos?|kilograms?|weight|wt|mass) (per )?(metre|meter|m|lm)$/.test(norm(n));
    });
    if (exact) return exact;
    var both = _partCfs.find(function (n) { var x = norm(n); return MASS.test(x) && METRE.test(x); });
    if (both) return both;
    return _partCfs.find(function (n) { return /^kgs?\b/.test(norm(n)); }) || '';
}

// tiinventorylog splits its numeric payload the same way the tag tables do:
// Count lands in infoInteger, everything else numeric in infoDouble.
function trkIsInt(def) {
    return TRK_INTEGER.indexOf(parseInt(def.trktype, 10)) !== -1;
}

// `wanted` is a saved tracking NAME — ids differ per database, names do not.
function pickTracking(wanted, typeIds, nameRe) {
    var pool = _partTrks.filter(function (t) { return typeIds.indexOf(parseInt(t.trktype, 10)) !== -1; });
    if (!pool.length) return null;
    if (wanted) {
        var exact = pool.find(function (t) { return String(t.trkname) === wanted; });
        if (exact) return exact;
        // The override names a field this part does not carry — fall through
        // to auto rather than silently showing nothing.
    }
    return pool.find(function (t) { return nameRe.test(String(t.trkname)) || nameRe.test(String(t.trkabbr)); }) || pool[0];
}

// ============================================================================
//  THE CARD QUERY
//  Four branches UNION-ed, wrapped so ORDER BY / LIMIT apply to the whole set.
//  Each branch converts its line quantity into the PART's base unit, because
//  the balance column has to add up in one unit:
//      qty_in_part_uom = qty_in_line_uom * uomconversion.multiply / .factor
//  Conversion rows only exist for pairs an administrator created, so a missing
//  row COALESCEs to 1 — which is correct whenever the line is already in the
//  part's own unit, and is the only safe assumption otherwise.
// ============================================================================
function dateClause(col) {
    var out = [];
    var from = safeDate(document.getElementById('dateFrom').value);
    var to   = safeDate(document.getElementById('dateTo').value);
    if (from) out.push(col + " >= '" + from + " 00:00:00'");
    // `< to + 1 day` rather than `<= to`, so a movement stamped at 14:32 on
    // the To date is still inside the range.
    if (to)   out.push(col + " < DATE_ADD('" + to + " 00:00:00', INTERVAL 1 DAY)");
    return out;
}

function lgClause(col) {
    var ids = selectedLgIds();
    return ids.length ? [col + ' IN (' + ids.join(',') + ')'] : [];
}

function buildCardSQL() {
    var P = _part.id;
    var U = _part.uomid;
    var withSched = !!_resolve('showScheduled', true);
    var conv = 'COALESCE(uc.multiply / uc.factor, 1)';

    // ── IN: what has actually been received ──────────────────────────────
    var recv = [
        'SELECT',
        "  'RECEIPT'                                            AS rowtype,",
        '  COALESCE(ri.dateReceived, ri.dateLastModified)       AS evdate,',
        "  COALESCE(v.name, rcust.name, CONCAT('Transfer from ', fromlg.name), '') AS party,",
        // The SUPPLIER's invoice number lives on the PO header's Vendor SO #.
        // A receipt against a SALES order is a customer return coming back in;
        // it has no vendor invoice, so the SO number is the reference that
        // actually identifies it. Verified against a live database, where
        // every return receipt otherwise showed a blank Invoice No.
        "  COALESCE(NULLIF(po.vendorSO, ''), rso.num, '')       AS invoiceno,",
        "  COALESCE(po.num, rso.num, rxo.num, '')               AS orderno,",
        '  COALESCE(poi.unitCost, ri.billedUnitCost, 0)         AS price,',
        '  COALESCE(poi.mcUnitCost, ri.mcBilledUnitCost, 0)     AS mcprice,',
        "  COALESCE(pcur.code, '')                              AS currcode,",
        '  ri.qty * ' + conv + '                                AS qtybase,',
        '  ri.qty                                               AS qtyline,',
        "  COALESCE(poi.note, '')                               AS linenote,",
        '  ri.id                                                AS recid,',
        '  ' + TID_RECEIPTITEM + '                              AS tabid,',
        "  COALESCE(po.num, rso.num, rxo.num, '')               AS ordernum,",
        "  CASE WHEN po.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PO'",
        "       WHEN rso.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SO'",
        "       WHEN rxo.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'XO' ELSE '' END   AS ordertype,",
        "  COALESCE(rlg.name, '')                               AS lgname,",
        "  COALESCE(ru.code, '')                                AS uomcode",
        'FROM receiptitem ri',
        'JOIN receipt rc                ON rc.id     = ri.receiptId',
        'LEFT JOIN poitem poi           ON poi.id    = ri.poItemId',
        'LEFT JOIN po                   ON po.id     = COALESCE(poi.poId, rc.poId)',
        'LEFT JOIN vendor v             ON v.id      = po.vendorId',
        'LEFT JOIN currency pcur        ON pcur.id   = po.currencyId',
        'LEFT JOIN so rso               ON rso.id    = rc.soId',
        'LEFT JOIN customer rcust       ON rcust.id  = rso.customerId',
        'LEFT JOIN xo rxo               ON rxo.id    = rc.xoId',
        'LEFT JOIN locationgroup fromlg ON fromlg.id = rxo.fromLGId',
        'LEFT JOIN locationgroup rlg    ON rlg.id    = rc.locationGroupId',
        'LEFT JOIN uom ru               ON ru.id     = ri.uomId',
        'LEFT JOIN uomconversion uc     ON uc.fromUomId = ri.uomId AND uc.toUomId = ' + U,
        // statusId >= 30 is Received / Fulfilled. A line still Entered or
        // Reconciled has not physically arrived, and counting it would put
        // stock on the card that is not in the rack.
        'WHERE ri.partId = ' + P + ' AND ri.statusId >= 30 AND ri.qty <> 0'
    ].concat(pfx(dateClause('COALESCE(ri.dateReceived, ri.dateLastModified)')))
     .concat(pfx(lgClause('rc.locationGroupId')));

    // ── OUT: what has actually shipped ───────────────────────────────────
    var ship = [
        'SELECT',
        "  'SHIPMENT',",
        '  COALESCE(sh.dateShipped, sh.dateLastModified),',
        '  c.name,',
        // Our own invoice number IS the sales order number.
        '  so.num,',
        "  COALESCE(so.customerPO, ''),",
        '  COALESCE(soi.unitPrice, 0),',
        // soitem carries no mcUnitPrice — only the line total in the order
        // currency — so the per-unit figure has to be derived.
        '  COALESCE(soi.mcTotalPrice / NULLIF(soi.qtyOrdered, 0), 0),',
        "  COALESCE(scur.code, ''),",
        '  -si.qtyShipped * ' + conv + ',',
        '  -si.qtyShipped,',
        "  COALESCE(soi.note, ''),",
        '  si.id,',
        '  ' + TID_SHIPITEM + ',',
        '  so.num,',
        "  'SO',",
        "  COALESCE(slg.name, ''),",
        "  COALESCE(su.code, '')",
        'FROM shipitem si',
        'JOIN ship sh               ON sh.id  = si.shipId',
        'JOIN soitem soi            ON soi.id = si.soItemId',
        'JOIN so                    ON so.id  = soi.soId',
        'JOIN customer c            ON c.id   = so.customerId',
        'JOIN product pr            ON pr.id  = soi.productId',
        'LEFT JOIN currency scur    ON scur.id = so.currencyId',
        'LEFT JOIN locationgroup slg ON slg.id = sh.locationGroupId',
        'LEFT JOIN uom su           ON su.id  = si.uomId',
        'LEFT JOIN uomconversion uc ON uc.fromUomId = si.uomId AND uc.toUomId = ' + U,
        // ship.statusId 30 = Shipped. A packed-but-not-shipped carton has not
        // left, so it belongs on the Due out side, not here.
        'WHERE pr.partId = ' + P + ' AND sh.statusId = 30 AND si.qtyShipped <> 0'
    ].concat(pfx(dateClause('COALESCE(sh.dateShipped, sh.dateLastModified)')))
     .concat(pfx(lgClause('sh.locationGroupId')));

    var parts = [recv.join('\n'), ship.join('\n')];

    if (withSched) {
        // ── IN: still on order ───────────────────────────────────────────
        var onorder = [
            'SELECT',
            "  'ONORDER',",
            '  poi.dateScheduledFulfillment,',
            '  v.name,',
            "  COALESCE(po.vendorSO, ''),",
            '  po.num,',
            '  COALESCE(poi.unitCost, 0),',
            '  COALESCE(poi.mcUnitCost, 0),',
            "  COALESCE(pcur.code, ''),",
            '  (poi.qtyToFulfill - COALESCE(poi.qtyFulfilled, 0)) * ' + conv + ',',
            '  (poi.qtyToFulfill - COALESCE(poi.qtyFulfilled, 0)),',
            "  COALESCE(poi.note, ''),",
            '  poi.id,',
            '  0,',
            '  po.num,',
            "  'PO',",
            "  COALESCE(plg.name, ''),",
            "  COALESCE(pu.code, '')",
            'FROM poitem poi',
            'JOIN po                    ON po.id = poi.poId',
            'JOIN vendor v              ON v.id  = po.vendorId',
            'LEFT JOIN currency pcur    ON pcur.id = po.currencyId',
            'LEFT JOIN locationgroup plg ON plg.id = po.locationGroupId',
            'LEFT JOIN uom pu           ON pu.id = poi.uomId',
            'LEFT JOIN uomconversion uc ON uc.fromUomId = poi.uomId AND uc.toUomId = ' + U,
            // typeId 10/11 are the purchase lines — the ones that bring stock
            // in. 20/30 are out-of-stock and credit-return lines and are not
            // incoming supply.
            // po.statusId 20..55 is Issued through Shipped: an order that has
            // been placed and not yet closed. A Bid Request is not supply.
            'WHERE poi.partId = ' + P,
            '  AND poi.typeId IN (10, 11)',
            '  AND po.statusId BETWEEN 20 AND 55',
            '  AND (poi.qtyToFulfill - COALESCE(poi.qtyFulfilled, 0)) > 0'
        ].concat(pfx(dateClause('poi.dateScheduledFulfillment')))
         .concat(pfx(lgClause('po.locationGroupId')));

        // ── OUT: still due out ───────────────────────────────────────────
        var dueout = [
            'SELECT',
            "  'DUEOUT',",
            '  soi.dateScheduledFulfillment,',
            '  c.name,',
            '  so.num,',
            "  COALESCE(so.customerPO, ''),",
            '  COALESCE(soi.unitPrice, 0),',
            '  COALESCE(soi.mcTotalPrice / NULLIF(soi.qtyOrdered, 0), 0),',
            "  COALESCE(scur.code, ''),",
            '  -(soi.qtyOrdered - COALESCE(soi.qtyFulfilled, 0)) * ' + conv + ',',
            '  -(soi.qtyOrdered - COALESCE(soi.qtyFulfilled, 0)),',
            "  COALESCE(soi.note, ''),",
            '  soi.id,',
            '  0,',
            '  so.num,',
            "  'SO',",
            "  COALESCE(slg.name, ''),",
            "  COALESCE(su.code, '')",
            'FROM soitem soi',
            'JOIN so                    ON so.id = soi.soId',
            'JOIN customer c            ON c.id  = so.customerId',
            'JOIN product pr            ON pr.id = soi.productId',
            'LEFT JOIN currency scur    ON scur.id = so.currencyId',
            'LEFT JOIN locationgroup slg ON slg.id = so.locationGroupId',
            'LEFT JOIN uom su           ON su.id = soi.uomId',
            'LEFT JOIN uomconversion uc ON uc.fromUomId = soi.uomId AND uc.toUomId = ' + U,
            // so.statusId 20/25 = Issued / In Progress — a live order.
            // soitem.typeId 20/21 are credit returns (stock coming back, not
            // going out) and 30/40 are discount lines; none of them is demand.
            // soitem.statusId 50/60/70/75 = Fulfilled / Closed Short / Voided /
            // Cancelled — nothing left to ship.
            'WHERE pr.partId = ' + P,
            '  AND so.statusId IN (20, 25)',
            '  AND soi.typeId NOT IN (20, 21, 30, 40)',
            '  AND soi.statusId NOT IN (50, 60, 70, 75)',
            '  AND (soi.qtyOrdered - COALESCE(soi.qtyFulfilled, 0)) > 0'
        ].concat(pfx(dateClause('soi.dateScheduledFulfillment')))
         .concat(pfx(lgClause('so.locationGroupId')));

        parts.push(onorder.join('\n'), dueout.join('\n'));
    }

    return 'SELECT * FROM (\n' + parts.join('\nUNION ALL\n') +
           '\n) card\nORDER BY evdate, rowtype\nLIMIT 5000';
}
function pfx(list) { return list.map(function (c) { return '  AND ' + c; }); }

// Batch + average length for the movements that have actually happened.
// Kept as its own small query rather than joined into each UNION branch: the
// branches would each materialise their own copy of it, and the shipped line's
// tracking cannot be read off shipitem.tagId at all (it is always 0) — it has
// to come through inventorylog -> tiinventorylog.
function buildTrackingSQL() {
    if (!_batchTrk && !_lenTrk) return null;
    var ids = [];
    if (_batchTrk) ids.push(parseInt(_batchTrk.trkid, 10));
    if (_lenTrk)   ids.push(parseInt(_lenTrk.trkid, 10));
    return [
        'SELECT il.tableId AS tabid, il.recordId AS recid,',
        _batchTrk
            ? "  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pt.id = " + parseInt(_batchTrk.trkid, 10) + " THEN NULLIF(TRIM(til.info), '') END SEPARATOR ' | ') AS batch,"
            : '  NULL AS batch,',
        _lenTrk
            ? '  AVG(CASE WHEN pt.id = ' + parseInt(_lenTrk.trkid, 10) + ' THEN ' +
              (trkIsInt(_lenTrk) ? 'til.infoInteger' : 'til.infoDouble') + ' END) AS avglen'
            : '  NULL AS avglen',
        'FROM inventorylog il',
        'JOIN tiinventorylog til ON til.inventoryLogId = il.id',
        'JOIN parttracking pt    ON pt.id = til.partTrackingId',
        'WHERE il.partId = ' + _part.id,
        '  AND il.tableId IN (' + TID_RECEIPTITEM + ', ' + TID_SHIPITEM + ')',
        '  AND til.partTrackingId IN (' + ids.join(',') + ')',
        'GROUP BY il.tableId, il.recordId'
    ].join('\n');
}

// Two scalars that anchor the card to reality:
//   onhandnow      what is physically in the rack right now
//   movedafterfrom every inventorylog movement since the range start, so
//                  B/F = onhandnow - movedafterfrom is what was on hand the
//                  day the card opens
//   movedinrange   the same sum bounded by the To date, so the closing ACTUAL
//                  balance is B/F + movedinrange even on a back-dated range
function buildScalarsSQL() {
    var P = _part.id;
    var lgTag = selectedLgIds().length ? ' AND l.locationGroupId IN (' + selectedLgIds().join(',') + ')' : '';
    var lgLog = selectedLgIds().length ? ' AND il.locationGroupId IN (' + selectedLgIds().join(',') + ')' : '';
    // See LOG_TYPE_YIELD — those rows double-count, so any net-movement sum
    // that includes them makes B/F nonsense.
    var exYld = ' AND il.typeId <> ' + LOG_TYPE_YIELD;
    var from = safeDate(document.getElementById('dateFrom').value);
    var to   = safeDate(document.getElementById('dateTo').value);
    var afterFrom = from ? " AND il.eventDate >= '" + from + " 00:00:00'" : '';
    var inRange = afterFrom + (to ? " AND il.eventDate < DATE_ADD('" + to + " 00:00:00', INTERVAL 1 DAY)" : '');
    return [
        'SELECT',
        '  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.qty), 0) FROM tag t',
        '     JOIN location l ON l.id = t.locationId',
        '    WHERE t.partId = ' + P + ' AND t.typeId IN (' + ONHAND_TAG_TYPES + ')' + lgTag + ') AS onhandnow,',
        '  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(il.changeQty), 0) FROM inventorylog il',
        '    WHERE il.partId = ' + P + lgLog + exYld + afterFrom + ') AS movedafterfrom,',

    ].join('\n');

async function loadCard() {
    if (!_part) { renderAll(); return; }
    var mySeq = ++_loadSeq;
    var btn = document.getElementById('refreshBtn');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Building the card for ' + _part.num + '…');
    try {
        var cardSql = buildCardSQL();
        var trkSql  = buildTrackingSQL();
        var scaSql  = buildScalarsSQL();
        debugLog('Card query:\n' + cardSql, 'query');
        if (trkSql) debugLog('Tracking query:\n' + trkSql, 'query');
        debugLog('Scalars query:\n' + scaSql, 'query');

        var results = await Promise.all([
            qp(cardSql),
            trkSql ? qp(trkSql) : Promise.resolve([]),
            qp(scaSql)
        ]);
        if (mySeq !== _loadSeq) return;        // a newer load superseded us

        _rows = buildCard(results[0] || [], results[1] || [], (results[2] || [])[0] || {});
        debugLog('Card built — ' + _rows.length + ' row(s), B/F ' + kg(_summary.bf) +
                 ', close ' + kg(_summary.close) + ', on hand ' + kg(_summary.onhand), 'success');
        renderAll();
    } catch (e) {
        if (mySeq !== _loadSeq) return;
        console.error('[Product Card] load failed:', e);
        _rows = [];
        renderAll();
        setStatus('Load failed — ' + errText(e));
        debugLog('Load failed: ' + errText(e), 'error');
        showToast('Could not build the card: ' + errText(e), 'error', 8000);
    } finally {
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    }
}

// Merge the three result sets into the finished card and roll the balance
// forward. Everything downstream reads `_rows` and `_summary`.
function buildCard(raw, trkRows, scalars) {
    // ── tracking, keyed on (tableId, recordId) ───────────────────────────
    var trk = Object.create(null);
    trkRows.forEach(function (t) {
        trk[String(t.tabid) + ':' + String(t.recid)] = {
            batch: t.batch || '',
            avglen: parseNum(t.avglen)
        };
    });

    var kgpm = _part ? parseNum(_part.kgpm) : 0;

    var rows = raw.map(function (r) {
        var meta = TYPE_META[r.rowtype] || TYPE_META.RECEIPT;
        var key = String(r.tabid) + ':' + String(r.recid);
        var t = (meta.actual && trk[key]) ? trk[key] : { batch: '', avglen: 0 };
        var qtybase = parseNum(r.qtybase);

        // Bars. The line note is what the customer actually asked for, so it
        // wins; the weight-derived figure is a fallback and is marked as one.
        var noted = barsFromNote(r.linenote);
        var bars = noted;
        var derived = false;
        if (bars == null && kgpm > 0 && t.avglen > 0) {
            bars = Math.abs(qtybase) / (kgpm * t.avglen);
            derived = true;
        }

        return {
            rowtype:  r.rowtype,
            // Normalised to the ISO "T" form. The Date column sorts as a
            // STRING, and mixing "2026-09-18 14:00" with "2026-09-18T00:00"
            // sorted the space-separated row first (space is below "T"), so
            // clicking Date reordered the grid out of step with the balances,
            // which are computed in real date order.
            evdate:   normDate(r.evdate),
            party:    r.party || '',
            invoiceno: r.invoiceno || '',
            orderno:  r.orderno || '',
            price:    parseNum(r.price),
            mcprice:  parseNum(r.mcprice),
            currcode: r.currcode || '',
            batch:    t.batch,
            avglen:   t.avglen || null,
            bars:     bars == null ? null : bars,
            barsderived: derived,
            qtybase:  qtybase,
            qtyline:  parseNum(r.qtyline),
            uomcode:  r.uomcode || '',
            linenote: r.linenote || '',
            lgname:   r.lgname || '',
            ordernum: r.ordernum || '',
            ordertype: r.ordertype || '',
            actual:   meta.actual,
            _ord:     meta.ord,
            _t:       dateMs(r.evdate)
        };
    });

    // Date order, with the tie-break that reads correctly on a ledger: on one
    // date, what came in before what went out, and history before forecast.
    rows.sort(function (a, b) { return (a._t - b._t) || (a._ord - b._ord); });

    // ── OPENING BALANCE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // B/F is on-hand NOW less every net movement since the range start, so on
    // the whole card it comes out at 0 and the closing figure lands on real
    // on-hand. That only holds because the yield duplicates are kept out of
    // the sum — see LOG_TYPE_YIELD.
    var onhand    = parseNum(scalars.onhandnow);
    var afterFrom = parseNum(scalars.movedafterfrom);
    var inRange   = parseNum(scalars.movedinrange);
    var bf = onhand - afterFrom;

    // ── TWO PASSES, and the split is the whole point ─────────────────────
    // A forecast row must NEVER shift a historical balance. Rolling one
    // sequence across every row in date order let an overdue On-order line
    // sitting in the middle of the card lift every later Receipt and Shipment
    // balance with it, so the card could not close on real on-hand. History
    // rolls on its own; the forecast then continues from where history ended.
    var actualRows = [];
    var schedRows  = [];
    rows.forEach(function (r) { (r.actual ? actualRows : schedRows).push(r); });

    var byDate = function (a, b) { return (a._t - b._t) || (a._ord - b._ord); };

    var actualSum = actualRows.reduce(function (a, r) { return a + r.qtybase; }, 0);
    var unrecon = inRange - actualSum;

    // Stock the log saw that no order explains — an adjustment, a cycle
    // count, a transfer between sites. It gets its own dated row so the
    // running balance ties to real on-hand rather than quietly drifting. When
    // the orders already account for everything this is 0 and no row appears.
    if (Math.abs(unrecon) > 0.0005 && _resolve('showRecon', true)) {
        actualRows.push({
            rowtype: 'ADJUST',
            evdate: isoDateTime(new Date()),
            party: 'Adjustments / transfers (not on an order)',
            invoiceno: '', orderno: '', price: 0, mcprice: 0, currcode: '',
            batch: '', avglen: null, bars: null, barsderived: false,
            qtybase: unrecon, qtyline: unrecon, uomcode: _part ? _part.uomcode : '',
            linenote: 'The difference between what the orders account for and what Fishbowl actually holds.',
            lgname: '', ordernum: '', ordertype: '',
            actual: true, _ord: TYPE_META.ADJUST.ord, _t: Date.now()
        });
    }
    actualRows.sort(byDate);
    schedRows.sort(byDate);

    // PASS 1 — history only.
    var bal = bf, inKg = 0, outKg = 0;
    actualRows.forEach(function (r) {
        bal += r.qtybase;
        r.balance = bal;
        r.projected = false;
        if (r.qtybase > 0) inKg += r.qtybase; else outKg += -r.qtybase;
    });
    var close = bal;            // == on-hand whenever the range runs to today

    // PASS 2 — the forecast, continuing from the closing actual balance.
    schedRows.forEach(function (r) {
        bal += r.qtybase;
        r.balance = bal;
        r.projected = true;
        if (r.qtybase > 0) inKg += r.qtybase; else outKg += -r.qtybase;
    });

    _summary = {
        bf: bf, onhand: onhand, inKg: inKg, outKg: outKg,
        close: close, projected: bal, unrecon: unrecon,
        // How far the closing actual balance misses real on-hand. Non-zero
        // only when the reconciliation row is switched off, or the range is
        // capped before today.
        drift: onhand - close
    };

    // History above the forecast, each in date order, so the Balance column
    // reads straight down the page. Interleaving them by date would print a
    // forecast balance in the middle of history it does not belong to.
    return actualRows.concat(schedRows);
}

// "5 bars", "5 BAR", "bars: 5", "5x bars" — Courtney types it the way she
// types it, and the pick ticket has to carry whatever she wrote.
function barsFromNote(note) {
    var s = oneLine(note);
    if (!s) return null;
    var m = s.match(/(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(?:x\s*)?bars?\b/i) ||
            s.match(/\bbars?\s*[:=]?\s*(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)/i);
    if (!m) return null;
    var n = parseNum(m[1]);
    return n > 0 ? n : null;
}

// Positioned against the hovered header, flipping below it when there is no

function tipShow(event, html) {
    var el = document.getElementById('appTooltip');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML = html;
    var tw = 340;
    var r = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    var x = Math.min(window.innerWidth - tw - 12, r.left);
    el.style.left = Math.max(12, x) + 'px';
    // A sticky header sits at the very top of the scroll container, so there
    // is almost never room above it — below is the normal case here.
    var aboveY = r.top - el.offsetHeight - 8;
    el.style.top = (aboveY < 8 ? (r.bottom + 8) : aboveY) + 'px';
    el.classList.add('show');
}

// ============================================================================
//  DATE RANGE
//  A preset writes concrete dates into the From / To inputs, so the SQL only
//  ever reads those two values and "custom" needs no special case.
// ============================================================================
function applyPresetToInputs() {
    var preset = document.getElementById('datePreset').value;
    var fromEl = document.getElementById('dateFrom');
    var toEl   = document.getElementById('dateTo');
    if (preset === 'custom') return;

    var today = new Date();
    var from = null, to = null;
    if (preset === 'all') {
        from = null; to = null;
    } else if (preset === 'ytd') {
        from = new Date(today.getFullYear(), 0, 1); to = null;
    } else if (preset === 'fy') {
        // Australian financial year — July to June.
        var y = today.getMonth() >= 6 ? today.getFullYear() : today.getFullYear() - 1;
        from = new Date(y, 6, 1); to = null;
    } else {
        var days = parseInt(preset, 10);
        if (!isNaN(days)) { from = new Date(today.getTime()); from.setDate(from.getDate() - days); to = null; }
    }
    fromEl.value = from ? isoDate(from) : '';
    // The To box is left alone by every preset: the card is meant to run right
    // through today and on into what is still due, so capping it is always a
    // deliberate act.
    if (to) toEl.value = isoDate(to);
}

        var o2 = document.createElement('option');
        o2.value = current; o2.textContent = current + '  (not on this product)';
        sel.appendChild(o2);
    }
    sel.value = current || '';
}

// ============================================================================
//  COLUMNS PANEL
//  FBLib.Table owns order / width / sort (and persists them itself on drag).
//  Visibility has no public setter, so toggling writes the same settings blob
//  the Table reads — keeping every other field it holds — and then repaints.
// ============================================================================
function buildColPanel() {
    var host = document.getElementById('colList');
    host.innerHTML = '';
    _table.getColumns().forEach(function (col) {
        var label = document.createElement('label');
        var cb = document.createElement('input');
        cb.type = 'checkbox';
        cb.checked = col.vis !== false;
        if (col.key === 'evdate' || col.key === 'qtybase' || col.key === 'balance') {
            cb.disabled = true;
            label.title = 'Date, In/Out and Balance are what makes this a card';
        }
        cb.addEventListener('change', function () { setColumnVisible(col.key, cb.checked); });
        var span = document.createElement('span');
        span.textContent = col.label;
        label.appendChild(cb); label.appendChild(span);
        host.appendChild(label);
    });
}

function setColumnVisible(key, visible) {
    var cols = _table.getColumns();
    var col = cols.find(function (c) { return c.key === key; });
    if (!col) return;
    col.vis = !!visible;
    var saved = _resolve('tablePrefs', null);
    if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') saved = {};
    saved.order = cols.map(function (c) { return c.key; });
    saved.hidden = cols.filter(function (c) { return c.vis === false; }).map(function (c) { return c.key; });
    _setUserKey('tablePrefs', saved);
    _table.render();
    applyRowClasses();
    applyHeaderTips();
}

function toggleColPanel() { document.getElementById('colPanel').classList.toggle('hidden'); }

function resetColLayout() {
    if (!confirm('Reset column order, widths and visibility to the defaults?')) return;
    _setUserKey('tablePrefs', null);
    _table.setColumns(_columns.map(function (c) { return Object.assign({}, c); }));
    buildColPanel();
    _table.render();
    applyRowClasses();
    applyHeaderTips();
}

// ============================================================================
//  EXPORT + PRINT
// ============================================================================
function visibleExportCols() {
    return _table.getColumns().filter(function (c) { return c.vis !== false; });
}

// Plain text for a cell — the on-screen formatter emits HTML or a Node, so
// format the underlying value here instead of scraping the DOM.
function cellText(col, row) {
    var raw = row[col.key];
    if (col.key === 'evdate')  return fmtDate(raw);
    if (col.key === 'rowtype') return (TYPE_META[raw] || {}).label || String(raw || '');
    if (raw == null || raw === '') return '';
    if (col.key === 'avglen')  return num(raw, 3);
    if (col.key === 'bars')    return num(raw, 0);
    if (col.money) return fmtMoney(raw);
    if (col.qty)   return num(raw, kgDp());
    return oneLine(String(raw));
}

function exportTitle() {
    return 'Product card — ' + (_part ? _part.num : '');
}
function exportSubtitle() {
    var u = _part && _part.uomcode ? ' ' + _part.uomcode : '';
    var bits = [
        _part ? (_part.description || '') : '',
        'B/F ' + kg(_summary.bf) + u,
        'closing ' + kg(_summary.close) + u,
        'on hand ' + kg(_summary.onhand) + u
    ];
    if (_part && _part.kgpm > 0) bits.splice(1, 0, num(_part.kgpm, 3) + ' kg/m');
    return bits.filter(Boolean);
}
function exportFilename() {
    return 'BrightSteel_ProductCard_' +
           FBLib.Export.slug(_part ? _part.num : 'part') + '_' + FBLib.Export.stamp();
}

function exportCsv() {
    var rows = cardRows();
    if (!rows.length) { showToast('Nothing to export.', 'warn'); return; }
    var cols = visibleExportCols();
    // Every cell is pre-formatted to text here, so the exported columns carry
    // no money/date/qty type — FBLib.Export must not re-format what is already
    // formatted.
    var flatCols = cols.map(function (c) { return { key: c.key, label: c.label }; });
    var flatRows = rows.map(function (r) {
        var o = {};
        cols.forEach(function (c) { o[c.key] = cellText(c, r); });
        return o;
    });
    FBLib.Export.csv({ cols: flatCols, rows: flatRows, filename: exportFilename() });
    debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' row(s) to CSV', 'success');
}

async function exportXlsx() {
    var rows = cardRows();
    if (!rows.length) { showToast('Nothing to export.', 'warn'); return; }
    var cols = visibleExportCols();
    try {
        await FBLib.Export.xlsx({
            filename: exportFilename(),
            sheet: {
                name: 'Product card',
                title: exportTitle(),
                subtitle: exportSubtitle().concat([new Date().toLocaleString()]),
                cols: cols.map(function (c) {
                    return {
                        key: c.key, label: c.label,
                        w: Math.round((c.width || 110) / 7),
                        // Balance is a running figure, so it must NOT be
                        // totalled — it is typed as text-ish qty without the
                        // totals contribution by being excluded below.
                        qty: !!c.qty && c.key !== 'balance',
                        money: !!c.money,
                        date: c.key === 'evdate'
                    };
                }),
                rows: rows.map(function (r) {
                    var o = {};
                    cols.forEach(function (c) {
                        if (c.key === 'balance') { o[c.key] = num(r.balance, kgDp()); return; }
                        if (c.key === 'evdate')  { o[c.key] = r.evdate; return; }
                        if (c.qty || c.money)    { o[c.key] = r[c.key] == null ? '' : parseNum(r[c.key]); return; }
                        o[c.key] = cellText(c, r);
                    });
                    return o;
                }),
                totals: true
            }
        });
        debugLog('Exported ' + rows.length + ' row(s) to xlsx', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        showToast('Excel export failed: ' + errText(e), 'error', 6000);
        debugLog('xlsx export failed: ' + errText(e), 'error');
    }
}

// window.print() is unreliable in JxBrowser — build the document, open a new
// window and print THAT. This is the one that replaces the paper card, so it
// is laid out to be readable pinned to a wall.
function printReport() {
    var rows = cardRows();
    var cols = visibleExportCols();
    var hdr = cols.map(function (c) {
        return '<th' + (c.align === 'right' ? ' class="nr"' : '') + '>' + escHtml(c.label) + '</th>';
    }).join('');

            if (c.key === 'qtybase' && parseNum(r.qtybase) > 0) v = '+' + v;
            return '<td' + (c.align === 'right' ? ' class="nr"' : '') + '>' + escHtml(v) + '</td>';

    var u = _part && _part.uomcode ? ' ' + _part.uomcode : '';

        'body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:8pt;margin:.4in;color:#111}' +
        'h2{font-size:13pt;margin:0 0 2px;color:#0B3140}' +
        '.sub{font-size:8pt;color:#506872;margin:0 0 4px}' +
        '.bf{font-size:9pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0 0 9px;color:#0B3140}' +
        'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}' +
        'th{background:#0B3140;color:#fff;font-size:7.5pt;padding:4px 5px;text-align:left;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        'td{font-size:8pt;padding:3px 5px;border-bottom:1px solid #E3E3E3}' +
        'tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#F7F7F7;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        'tr.sched td{background:#FCFBF6;font-style:italic;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        'tr.adj td{background:#F5E7DD;font-weight:bold;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        '.nr{text-align:right}@page{size:A4 landscape;margin:.4in}' +

        '<h2>' + escHtml(_part ? _part.num : '') + '</h2>' +

        '. Italic rows have not happened yet.</p>' +

    var w = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (!w) { showToast('The print window was blocked.', 'warn'); return; }

// ============================================================================
//  SETTINGS PANEL
// ============================================================================
function hydrateSettings() {
    document.getElementById('setShowScheduled').checked = !!_resolve('showScheduled', true);
    document.getElementById('setShowRecon').checked = !!_resolve('showRecon', true);
    document.getElementById('setDefaultPreset').value = String(_resolve('defaultPreset', 'all'));
    document.getElementById('setKgDp').value = String(_resolve('kgDp', '1'));
    document.getElementById('setDateDir').value = String(_resolve('dateDir', 'asc'));
    document.getElementById('setShowDebug').checked = !!_resolve('showDebug', false);
    document.getElementById('setRemember').checked = !!_resolve('remember', true);
    refreshFieldSelects();
}

function onSettingsChange() {
    var wasSched = !!_resolve('showScheduled', true);
    var wasRecon = !!_resolve('showRecon', true);
    _setUserKey('showScheduled', document.getElementById('setShowScheduled').checked);
    _setUserKey('showRecon', document.getElementById('setShowRecon').checked);
    _setUserKey('defaultPreset', document.getElementById('setDefaultPreset').value);
    _setUserKey('kgDp', document.getElementById('setKgDp').value);
    _setUserKey('dateDir', document.getElementById('setDateDir').value);
    _setUserKey('remember', document.getElementById('setRemember').checked);
    var showDebug = document.getElementById('setShowDebug').checked;
    _setUserKey('showDebug', showDebug);
    applyDebugDrawer(showDebug);

    // Both of these change WHICH rows exist, not just how they look, and the
    // balance has to be rolled again — so they re-query rather than repaint.
    var needReload = wasSched !== document.getElementById('setShowScheduled').checked ||
                     wasRecon !== document.getElementById('setShowRecon').checked;
    if (needReload && _part) loadCard(); else renderAll();
}

async function onFieldSettingChange() {
    _setUserKey('kgpmCf',   document.getElementById('setKgpmCf').value);
    _setUserKey('batchTrk', document.getElementById('setBatchTrk').value);
    _setUserKey('lenTrk',   document.getElementById('setLenTrk').value);
    if (!_part) { refreshFieldSelects(); return; }
    await resolvePartFields();
    await loadCard();
}

function resetSettings() {
    if (!confirm('Reset your personal settings to defaults?')) return;
    try { FBLib.Settings.clearUser(); } catch (_) {}
    hydrateSettings();
    applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
    hydrateFilters();
    if (_part) { resolvePartFields().then(loadCard); } else { renderAll(); }
}

function publishDefaults() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    if (!confirm('Publish the current Settings values as the default for all users?')) return;
    try {
        // publishMaster REPLACES the whole master object, so send every field
        // the org default is meant to carry — not just the one that changed.
        FBLib.Settings.publishMaster({
            kgpmCf:   document.getElementById('setKgpmCf').value,
            batchTrk: document.getElementById('setBatchTrk').value,
            lenTrk:   document.getElementById('setLenTrk').value,
            showScheduled: document.getElementById('setShowScheduled').checked,
            showRecon: document.getElementById('setShowRecon').checked,
            defaultPreset: document.getElementById('setDefaultPreset').value,
            kgDp: document.getElementById('setKgDp').value,
            dateDir: document.getElementById('setDateDir').value
        });
        showToast('Published as the default for everyone.', 'success');
        debugLog('Defaults published', 'success');
    } catch (e) { debugLog('publishDefaults: ' + errText(e), 'error'); }
}

function toggleUserEditing() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    try { FBLib.Settings.setLock(FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed()); refreshAdminUi(); }
    catch (e) { debugLog('toggleUserEditing: ' + errText(e), 'error'); }
}

function refreshAdminUi() {
    var isAdmin = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin();
    document.getElementById('dsAdminSection').style.display = isAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';
    var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
    document.getElementById('dsLockBadge').style.display = (!allowed && !isAdmin) ? 'block' : 'none';
    var lockBtn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
