}

// ============================================================================
//  DEBUG DRAWER
// ============================================================================
function applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
    if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
    if (!_debugApi) return;
    if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); } else _debugApi.hide();
    if (_debugApi.element) observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
}
function observeDebugDrawer(el) {
    if (!el || el._observed) return;
    el._observed = true;
    var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible'), open = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
    };
    apply();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') { try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {} }
    try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
}

// ============================================================================
//  SMALL HELPERS
// ============================================================================
function setStatus(msg) { document.getElementById('statusLine').textContent = msg; }

// runQueryAsync resolves to an already-parsed array; runQuery returns a JSON
// string. Prefer the async one and fall back so the report still works on an
// older client. NOTE the name — a report-level function called runQuery would
// shadow the built-in and recurse forever.
async function qp(sql) {
    if (typeof runQueryAsync === 'function') return normalise(await runQueryAsync(sql));
    return normalise(safeParse(runQuery(sql, 'true')));
}
function normalise(r) { if (!r) return []; return Array.isArray(r) ? r : [r]; }
function safeParse(s) { try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (_) { return null; } }

function escSQL(s) {
    if (window.FBLib && FBLib.Common && FBLib.Common.escSQL) return FBLib.Common.escSQL(s);
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/'/g, "''").replace(/\\/g, '\\\\');
}
function escHtml(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
        .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
}
function oneLine(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/\s*[\r\n]+\s*/g, ' ').trim(); }

// Tolerant number parse — custom-field values arrive as free text, so "0.761",
// "0,761" and "0.761 kg/m" all have to land on the same number.
function parseNum(v) {
    if (v == null) return 0;
    if (typeof v === 'number') return isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
    var s = String(v).trim();
    if (!s) return 0;
    if (s.indexOf(',') !== -1 && s.indexOf('.') === -1) s = s.replace(',', '.');
    else s = s.replace(/,/g, '');
    var m = s.match(/-?\d*\.?\d+/);
    var n = m ? parseFloat(m[0]) : NaN;
    return isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
}

function kgDp() { var d = parseInt(_resolve('kgDp', '1'), 10); return isNaN(d) ? 1 : d; }
function kg(v)  { return num(v, kgDp()); }
function num(v, dp) {
    var n = parseNum(v);
    return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp });
}

// MySQL hands datetimes back as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" or ISO with a T. Safari
// and some Chromium builds refuse the space form, so normalise before Date.
function dateMs(v) {
    if (!v) return 0;
    var s = String(v).replace(' ', 'T');
    var t = Date.parse(s);
    return isNaN(t) ? 0 : t;
}
// MySQL hands back "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" on some drivers and the ISO "T"
// form on others. Normalise to "T" so a lexicographic sort of the Date column
// is also a chronological one.
function normDate(v) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(' ', 'T'); }
function safeDate(s) { return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s || '') ? s : ''; }
function isoDate(d) {
    // Local date parts, not toISOString — that shifts to UTC and can land a
    // day early for anyone east of Greenwich.
    var m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    var day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + m + '-' + day;
}
function isoDateTime(d) {
    // "T", not a space — see normDate().
    return isoDate(d) + 'T' +
        String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' +
        String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') + ':00';
}

function errText(e) {
    if (!e) return 'unknown error';
    if (typeof e === 'string') return e;
    if (e.message) return e.message + (e.status != null ? ' (HTTP ' + e.status + ')' : '');
    if (e.status != null) return 'HTTP ' + e.status;
    try { return JSON.stringify(e); } catch (_) { return String(e); }
}

function showToast(message, type, duration) {
    var host = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'toast ' + (type || 'info');
    var ico = { success: '✓', error: '✕', warn: '⚠', info: 'ℹ' }[type || 'info'];
    var icon = document.createElement('span'); icon.className = 'toast-icon'; icon.textContent = ico;
    var msg = document.createElement('span'); msg.className = 'toast-msg'; msg.textContent = message;
    var x = document.createElement('button'); x.className = 'toast-x'; x.innerHTML = '×';
    x.addEventListener('click', function () { el.remove(); });
    el.appendChild(icon); el.appendChild(msg); el.appendChild(x);
    host.appendChild(el);
    setTimeout(function () {
        el.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function () { el.remove(); }, 260);
    }, duration || 4000);
}

function debounce(fn, ms) {
    var t = null;
    return function () {
        var args = arguments, self = this;
        clearTimeout(t);
        t = setTimeout(function () { fn.apply(self, args); }, ms);
    };
}

function clearAll() {
    _part = null; _rows = [];
    _summary = { bf: 0, onhand: 0, inKg: 0, outKg: 0, close: 0, projected: 0, unrecon: 0 };
    document.getElementById('partInput').value = '';
    closeAc();
    if (_resolve('remember', true)) _setUserKey('lastPart', '');
    renderAll();
    document.getElementById('partInput').focus();
}

// ============================================================================
//  INIT
// ============================================================================
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
    try {
        FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',  triggerId: 'setBtn'  });
        FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay', triggerId: 'helpBtn' });

        hydrateSettings();
        applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
        refreshAdminUi();

        var partEl = document.getElementById('partInput');
        partEl.addEventListener('input', onPartInput);
        partEl.addEventListener('keydown', onPartKeydown);
        partEl.addEventListener('blur', function () { setTimeout(closeAc, 120); });

        // Location group is applied in SQL, so a change re-reads the card.
        // Wired on close, not on every tick — one query per dropdown session.
        _lgMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
            containerId: 'lgMs', items: [], placeholder: 'All location groups',
            onClose: function () {
                _setUserKey('lgIds', _lgMs.getSelected());
                if (_part) loadCard();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var wrap = document.getElementById('colWrap');
            if (wrap && !wrap.contains(e.target)) document.getElementById('colPanel').classList.add('hidden');
        });

        _table = FBLib.Table.init({
            tableEl: document.getElementById('reportTable'),
            columns: _columns,
            getRows: cardRows,
            chunkSize: 250,
            settingsKey: 'tablePrefs',
            // The row tinting has to be re-applied after every repaint, and a
            // lazy chunk append counts as one.
            onSort: function () { setTimeout(function () { applyRowClasses(); applyHeaderTips(); }, 0); }
        });
        buildColPanel();
        // Lazy chunks append on scroll without going through onSort, so tint
        // whatever has just landed.
        var wrap = document.querySelector('.fb-table-container');
        if (wrap) wrap.addEventListener('scroll', debounce(applyRowClasses, 60));

        hydrateFilters();
        await Promise.all([loadLocationGroups(), loadPartCfs()]);

        var savedLg = _resolve('lgIds', null);
        if (_lgMs && Array.isArray(savedLg) && savedLg.length) _lgMs.setSelected(savedLg);

        var last = _resolve('remember', true) ? String(_resolve('lastPart', '') || '') : '';
        if (last) {
            partEl.value = last;
            await resolveTypedPart();
        } else {
            renderAll();
            partEl.focus();
        }

        debugLog('Report initialised', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[Product Card init] failed:', e);
        setStatus('Init failed — ' + errText(e));
        debugLog('Init failed: ' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack : errText(e)), 'error');
    }
});
